## Chess Game Performance Tracker

This report tracks my online chess games, analysing game results, how games ended, and opponent ratings over time.
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(readr))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))

logged_data <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vRLmgMdVP3_3FXNkUobq4ejv-SANg5xMsBokWolY0ydoKgt16sfBkFhZM8RYQMjxrAGcCicsFot9W41/pub?output=csv")

latest_data <- logged_data %>%
  rename(
    timestamp = Timestamp,
    result = `1. Game Results`,
    color = Color,
    ending = `How the game ended.`,
    opponent_rating = `Opponent Rating`,
    time_remaining = `My remaining time at end of game.`
  )

win_count <- sum(latest_data$result == "Win")
total_games <- nrow(latest_data)
win_rate <- round((win_count / total_games) * 100, 1)
mean_opponent <- round(mean(latest_data$opponent_rating), 0)

paste0("In total, ", total_games, " games have been logged. My win rate is ", win_rate, "%, with an average opponent rating of ", mean_opponent, ".")

ggplot(latest_data, aes(x = result, fill = result)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Chess Game Results",
       x = "Result",
       y = "Number of Games") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(latest_data, aes(x = ending, fill = ending)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "How Games Ended",
       x = "Ending Type",
       y = "Number of Games") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
